sources.entry: localpr by gilles-g - Reviews Claude's uncommitted changes in a local GitHub-style pull request page: comment on any line, send comments in batches while Claude keeps working, ask Claude questions answered inline in the thread, and get each comment back marked fixed or refused.

summary.one_liner: localpr is a standard-library Python tool that renders Claude's uncommitted changes as a local, offline GitHub-style pull request page where you can comment on lines and get each comment answered or applied by Claude.
summary.what_it_does: It generates a local HTML review page from the git diff of the working tree, a branch against a base, or another repository, and opens it without any network or service. You can comment on any line, and each comment is anchored to a line with a fingerprint so anchors can be re-found if the file changes. Comments are sent to Claude in batches with Send comments while the review continues, or all at once with Finish review, which writes a TODO.md that Claude Code reads. Each comment is tagged Must fix, Follow-up, or Workflow note, and comes back with a verdict such as fixed, refused, out-of-scope, or anchor-lost. The page also supports asking Claude one-off questions in a thread, replying in threads, and requesting a whole-diff review by a fresh agent whose suggestions can be taken up or dismissed. It has unified and split views, light, dark and dark dimmed themes, a searchable file tree, and Viewed checkboxes for files.
use_cases: review Claude's uncommitted code changes before committing
comment on specific diff lines and have an AI agent fix them
offline local code review of a git diff
batch code review feedback to an AI coding assistant
get a second-opinion review of a working tree or branch diff
how_to_run: Install the plugin: /plugin marketplace add gilles-g/localpr
In Claude Code, from any repository, run: /localpr:review
Optionally: /localpr:review --base develop to review the branch against develop
Open the printed page URL, comment, then use Send comments or Finish review
stack: HTML/CSS/JS inlined in the generated page
notable: Runs entirely offline with no service or account; the page works over file://
Comments are sent in batches while Claude keeps working on earlier ones
Each comment returns with a verdict: fixed, refused, out-of-scope, or anchor-lost
Never writes to the repository and runs no git write commands
Review suggestions from a fresh agent can be taken up or dismissed, and dismissed ones are not raised again
caveats: Requires Claude Code to drive the workflow; comments are read back by Claude via files in ~/.claude/reviews
Binary files, mode changes, submodules and nested repositories show only a one-line notice rather than a rendered diff
A comment on a deleted line cannot be re-anchored; the hunk travels with it instead
